messages:
jordan_support: FYI customer ACME reported invoice INV-2026-0456 shows a smaller prorated credit after a mid-cycle downgrade. They expected ~£412.50 credit, system generated £312.50. PO is on file and card fallback happened. @sam_finance can you investigate? Customer is UK-based (VAT applies).

alex_engineer: Quick Q — did ACME change billing-window or timezone? any recent migrations? Need event IDs to repro.

jordan_support: Event IDs: billing_event_id=be-0a9c4f2, charge_event=ce-77b2, plan change: pro -> starter. Effective_at: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z. Invoice period on record: 2026-02-01 -> 2026-03-01. Customer submitted PO before downgrade.

mira_billing_eng: Looking at ledger entries: proration_days computed as 22 instead of 30 for that change. That matches the shortfall (~£100). I see a migration on 2026-02-10 that flipped billing_window_align=false for migrated accounts. Likely bug where we used account-level window instead of subscription-level.

alex_engineer: I can repro in staging. Steps:
```
# reproduce proration discrepancy (staging)
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.test/recalculate \-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \-d '{"customer_id":"acme-corp","effective_at":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```
Observed: prorated_amount = 31250 (pence) -> £312.50
Expected: (monthly_price / 30) * unused_days -> £412.50
Working theory: when billing_window_align=false we compute unused_days relative to account.calendar_start instead of subscription.start, truncating the period. Opening branch fix/proration-window-align with unit tests.

sam_finance: Action items: we need a manual credit note asap. ACME wants the full prorated credit applied to account (they prefer credit over refund since PO exists). Also confirm VAT handling — UK standard 20% applied on the credit. @mira_billing_eng can you draft CN and mark it as manual_adjustment with external_ref=be-0a9c4f2? I'll prepare GL impact note.

mira_billing_eng: Drafting CN now. Propose CN-2026-0789 for amount £412.50 (net £343.75 + VAT £68.75). Ledger tag: adj_prorate_migration. I'll set status=unapplied_credit and leave note: "manual correction for proration calculation bug; pending post after approval." Need approval from @sam_finance to post.

sam_finance: Approved. Post CN-2026-0789 and leave as unapplied credit on ACME account. Do NOT issue card refund (they have PO). Also create a ticket BILL-4422 to track RCA + customer communications + accounting entry. Include sample calc and VAT split in ticket.

alex_engineer: Patch details: fix/proration-window-align adjusts proration base to subscription.billing_period boundaries and falls back to account only when subscription.start is null. Tests added for DST and migrated accounts. Plan: canary deploy tonight 23:00 UTC, 2h monitoring window, rollback if >0.5% deviation in total monthly invoice amount for canary cohort. I'll coordinate with eng-infra.

billing_bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for fix/proration-window-align at 2026-03-16T23:05:00Z :rocket:

jordan_support: :thumbsup: I'll update ACME: "We have issued credit note CN-2026-0789 for £412.50 to your account and it will be applied to the next invoice. We're rolling a fix to prevent recurrences; ticket BILL-4422 created. ETA for credit to reflect: 1 business day." Thanks everyone.
